comment: Client child for the self-contained (spawn-based) multiplayer scenario, launched by dummy_plug_net_host_scenario.json. Boots standalone (loads the CLI map locally), then joins the server via the net_connect event once its own load is done — event times are relative to app-loaded, so this lands well after the host's net_listen and inside GNS's connect-retry window even when both processes load concurrently. The join's GameJoin triggers a reload of the server's map (Remote origin), exercising the same path as a mid-session map switch. Then: gamepad movement, ride through the server-triggered switch to beavercreek, more movement, dump_state.
